snippet.title: 🚀 Aerial Raider — Official Trailer | iOS 🍎 | Android 🤖 | Steam
snippet.description:
👉 https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aerial-raider/id6745239973
The skies belong to no one.

Dive into Aerial Raider, a high-intensity top-down aerial combat game where you pilot cutting-edge fighters against the Varkari invasion. With an arsenal of power-ups, options for both high res 3D and 2D ships, and 3 unique minigames, Aerial Raider blends retro arcade action with modern mobile polish.

💥 FEATURES
 • Cinematic bursts of aerial chaos
 • Epic soundtrack and vibrant pixel art
 • Unlockable abilities, shields, weapons, and more
 • 3 bonus minigames to test your reflexes

🌌 Uncover the story behind the Varkari threat as you fight to reclaim Earth’s skies.

🍎 Available now on iOS! 👉 https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aerial-raider/id6745239973
📱 Coming SOON to Android!

🔔 Subscribe for future updates and gameplay reveals
👍 Like the video if you’re ready to take flight
